name: POV Screen Demo
description: A first-person product walkthrough built from the real app screens, with a short hook and step labels layered over the interface. Use it when seeing the product work is the proof.

hook.description: The short outcome promised in the opening overlay.

steps.description: The 2-3 actions the viewer sees in the product, as a list.

nodes.system: You write concise on-screen copy for a vertical product walkthrough. The screen is the proof. Keep every line immediately readable and never repeat an interface label.

nodes.prompt: First-person phone screen walkthrough of the supplied real product interface. A cursor or thumb completes the described steps: {{inputs.steps}}. Slow, deliberate movement; preserve all interface pixels and do not generate any new words. A plain narrator says: "{{script.spoken_line}}".
nodes.negative_prompt: watermark, subtitles, added text, distorted UI, garbled interface text
